# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand: python tools/generate_west_panel.py
#
# Per-prefecture West actions. One copy per prefecture because a panel button cannot pass
# a country: each wraps cc_byz_west_pf_save_effect plus one shared body in
# scripted_effects/cc_byz_west_prefecture_effects.txt. type = situation with the usual
# situation select_trigger, which is what binds scope:recipient to the parameter the panel
# button passes. Cooldowns are timed variables on the empire, checked in allow so the
# button tooltip says why it is disabled.

cc_byz_west_pf_donative_italy = {
	type = situation
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 30
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 30

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:cc_byz_the_west = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}

	potential = {
		cc_byz_west_pf_action_potential_trigger = { PF = italy }
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cc_byz_west_pf_cooldown_tt
			scope:actor = { NOT = { has_variable = cc_byz_west_donative_cd_italy } }
		}
		scope:actor = { gold >= 75 }
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			set_variable = { name = cc_byz_west_donative_cd_italy  value = yes  years = 5 }
			cc_byz_west_pf_save_effect = { PF = italy }
			cc_byz_west_pf_donative_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { cc_byz_west_publish_effect = yes }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = 12 }
}

cc_byz_west_pf_confirm_son_italy = {
	type = situation
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 12
	price = price:cc_byz_west_minor_price

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:cc_byz_the_west = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}

	potential = {
		cc_byz_west_pf_action_potential_trigger = { PF = italy }
		scope:actor = { any_subject = { cc_byz_exarch_in_italy_trigger = yes  NOT = { has_variable = cc_byz_exarch_hereditary } } }
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cc_byz_west_pf_needs_loyal_tt
			scope:actor = {
				any_subject = {
					cc_byz_exarch_in_italy_trigger = yes
					cc_byz_exarch_loyalty_at_least_trigger = { VALUE = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_byz_west_pf_save_effect = { PF = italy }
			cc_byz_west_pf_confirm_son_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { cc_byz_west_publish_effect = yes }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = 4 }
}

	potential = {
		cc_byz_west_pf_action_potential_trigger = { PF = gaul }
		scope:actor = { any_subject = { cc_byz_exarch_in_gaul_trigger = yes  NOT = { has_variable = cc_byz_exarch_hereditary } } }
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cc_byz_west_pf_needs_loyal_tt
			scope:actor = {
				any_subject = {
					cc_byz_exarch_in_gaul_trigger = yes
					cc_byz_exarch_loyalty_at_least_trigger = { VALUE = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_byz_west_pf_save_effect = { PF = gaul }
			cc_byz_west_pf_confirm_son_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { cc_byz_west_publish_effect = yes }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = 4 }
}

cc_byz_west_pf_strategos_gaul = {
	type = situation
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 60
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 60
	price = price:cc_byz_west_minor_price

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:cc_byz_the_west = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}

	potential = {
		cc_byz_west_pf_action_potential_trigger = { PF = gaul }
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cc_byz_west_pf_cooldown_tt
			scope:actor = { NOT = { has_variable = cc_byz_west_strategos_cd_gaul } }
		}
		scope:actor = { army_tradition >= 30 }
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			set_variable = { name = cc_byz_west_strategos_cd_gaul  value = yes  years = 20 }
			cc_byz_west_pf_save_effect = { PF = gaul }
			cc_byz_west_pf_strategos_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { cc_byz_west_publish_effect = yes }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = 6 }
}
